reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.comment: Great case. One of the best cases ive ever built in. The frameless glass on glass corner is very stable on the v2. The angled fan baseplate is nice and provides good airflow as does the side fan stack. Ive built easily 10 pcs for myself and a few others and this case has the best wire management holes and points to secure I’ve ever had the pleasure of working in. The included fans that are color matched look nice and quiet. I do have an AMD but i get low and stable temps while running in quiet mode. Kinda hard to beat 6 color matched fans for that price difference of the no fans included case version. Built well, looks good & easy to build in. Buy it
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Super cheap but the build quality is fantastic!
reviews.comment: What a case! I originally bought the HAVN HS420 and that thing is a monster. Massive. This guy, nice and compact. Perfect for sitting on the desk! Has a spot for 9 120mm fans and comes with 5 reverse blade fans if you go for the flow option. Nice fish tank PC case! Plenty of room for cable management with the 2 drive bays that you can remove. There's also a spot for 2 2.5" ssd's, so the HD cages aren't really necessary in todays world. The fans are nice but I upgraded them to RGB fans so I can have a warm white appearance. The fans that comes with the case start to make noise around the 800rpm mark. Which isn't bad at all! For sure the best case for the money rn.
reviews.author: Johns

reviews.title: Very Nice looking case
reviews.comment: Nice case. Good airflow. I got this over the version with the top glass because of the better top fan installation. Still looks great. It’s heavy though. There’s a possibility to install the GPU vertical but I think airflow suffer and an additional bracket is required. I kept it as is and it looks nice with LED fans.
reviews.author: KD

reviews.title: Great pc gaming case or anything case. LOVE IT
reviews.comment: Great case. Made a gaming pc. Love the features it has and the white color. Has cool way to move the wires around. Plenty of room for anything you put in. Last pic I built was 20 years ago, this was an awesome case. Has fans that are on an angle on bottom with a screen to collect dust. It’s easy to take apart and put back together. You can move the usb power button from front of case to top with just 4 screws to remove and put on top of you are placing on floor, so you do t have to bend all the way down to put usb in and turn on and off. Very functional
